aligned_ticks.note: Tick tham khảo được làm tròn ra ngoài; định giá dùng range liên tục trên lưới.

background_liquidity.future_liquidity: Current active L held constant across future days and prices
background_liquidity.tick_interval_convention: Right of each tick in ascending raw tick order

assumptions.exit_probability_definition: Ever outside range at daily observation times; intraday crossings unobserved.
assumptions.first_rebalance: May occur on day 1; min_gap separates subsequent recenters, matching supplied JS.
limitations: Forward scenario with frozen current active liquidity; not a historical backtest.
Daily endpoints miss intraday crossing; no MEV/JIT/funding/market impact.
No solvency constraint. Costs can exceed capital.
Annualized returns are extrapolations, not protocol APR.
live_data: Latest block is provisional and may be reorganized.
TVL and volume are provider aggregates with separate retrieval time.
Only current active liquidity captured; initialized tick distribution is not refreshed.
Historical calibration candles are pinned from the stored research dataset.
assumptions.policy_timing: Fees first; weekly/threshold recenter at current close for subsequent bars; hedge marked daily. No terminal LP recenter.
assumptions.quote_usd_assumption: Quote/USD held constant in each scenario, including WETH for WBTC/WETH; not a joint USD price forecast.
assumptions.rebalance_timing: At observed close, after fees for that bar; new range applies from next bar.

research.warning: Công cụ mô phỏng nghiên cứu, không phải lời khuyên đầu tư.

assumptions.solvency_constraint: Not imposed; separate cost account can yield negative total wealth at very large gas.
